steps.en: System reads the ID type of the reminder recipient
steps.id: Sistem membaca tipe ID penerima reminder

steps.en: Current offenders are queued for an address check
steps.id: Offender saat ini dimasukkan ke antrean pengecekan alamat

steps.en: Individuals are sent to the national registry for their address
steps.id: Individu dikirim ke registry nasional untuk dicek alamatnya

steps.en: Companies are sent to the business registry for their address
steps.id: Perusahaan dikirim ke registry bisnis untuk dicek alamatnya
steps.why_en: Company check is switched off in the production settings and skips the queue when no regular notices exist.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan perusahaan dimatikan di setelan produksi dan melewati antrean bila tidak ada notice reguler.
